notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
I'm pleased to share with you the details of this new update v1.2, where new and improved sound effects were added to create a more terrifying atmosphere. The HUD system was also enhanced, and the errors that occasionally appeared in the objective system were corrected. Finally, the achievement system compatible with Steam was implemented, allowing players to experience a real sense of progress.

I'll keep an eye on the community feedback for upcoming updates.



Thank you all for making this possible <3
~ Kros

notes.title: Update v1.0
notes.content:
Yours truly, the developer of Find Me, as of all the involved people in this project. We are all very grateful for the approval of our game, now that is finally done, we are excited to share this groundbreaking update with you.

With the v1.0 we were able of implementing all of the desired things into the game and, of course, we've taken into account all of the user reviews, positive or not, we've used them to achieve this new challenging and balanced experience, but should I say, a more terrifying one too.

This will not be the last update, we are constantly taking care of the community feedback, moreover, with the next patch we're gonna be adding more languages to the game and implementing the achievement acquiring on Steam, among other things.

It is worth mentioning that developing a videogame is really a challenge, even more when the personal circumstances are not by one's side, that's why I want to say thank you for all of your patience and to give the proper credits once more to all the persons that were by my side and contributed to this project.

I genuinely hope you enjoy this terrifying delivery. Until next time <3.

~ Kros

notes.title: Errors and added new features.
notes.content:
We have fixed errors and added new features. 

Mistakes:

- Error in the curtains.

- Translation error in warning message.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

New features:

- User settings can now be saved.

- You can end the presentation call.

- We have improved the sound of the steps.

------------------

Thanks to the whole community.

- KalaOh games

notes.title: Patch v0.10
notes.content:
